question: Does copying a far pointer parameter into a local (p = q) change how /Og loads it? Positive control f_1FAA_0006 (root:1FAA, complete TU): exact only with `p = q;` and p[...] accesses. The copy is propagated away (no store of its own); what remains is a split load `mov di,[bp+6]; mov es,[bp+8]` of the parameter, held in DI:ES and spilled to a temp. Indexing q directly gives `les di,[bp+6]` and a 3-byte-shorter function (295 vs 298). Same shape: S23 win_GetStyleTextHeight/win_PrintStyleTextInRect `mov bx,[bp+6]; mov es,[bp+8]`.

expect.local_copy@0: push di; push si; mov di, word ptr [bp + 6]; mov es, word ptr [bp + 8]
expect.direct@0: push di; push si; les di, ptr [bp + 6]
